scope: Proposition 7.1 (Boundary of an equality set) of the manuscript “Generalized Cartan–Hadamard isoperimetry and Euclidean equality rigidity” (preprints/Generalized-Cartan-Hadamard-isoperimetry-and-Euclidean-equality-rigidity-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 337 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a7310d708fef81ea), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 29. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Mn be complete, simply connected and smooth, with n ≥ 2 and secM ≤ 0. Suppose that a bounded measurable set E ⊂ M has positive volume V , finite ambient perimeter A, and A = nω1/n n V (n−1)/n . Put m = n − 1, R = (V/ωn)1/n, and H0 = m/R. The support Γ = supp |DχE| is compact and has a decomposition Γ = Σ ˙ ∪ Z with the following properties: 1. Σ is a relatively open, boundaryless, embedded C1,1 loc hypersurface, and Z is compact, with dimH Z ≤ n − 8. In particular, Z = ∅ when n < 8. 2. The side occupied by E defines an outward unit normal N on Σ, and |DχE| = dσ⌊Σ, σ(Σ) = A = smRm , Σ = Γ. (7.1) Here dσ denotes induced area on Σ, extended by zero to M. 3. There are C < ∞ and r0 > 0 such that σ ( Σ ∩ Br(x) ) ≤ Crm (x ∈ Γ, 0 < r < r0). (7.2) 4. The outward trace mean curvature satisfies H = divTΣ N = H0 almost everywhere on Σ. These assertions concern the perimeter support and the measurable class of E, not the topological boundary of an arbitrary representative.
